links.outcome: Diagnostic quality (Bond score, CIE) with versus without knowledge-graph grounding of LLM reasoning
links.effect: KGRD(DS) raised mean top-ranked diagnosis Bond score from 3.27 to 3.85 and CIE from 73.6% to 81.9%, with 35 additional cases at Bond score ≥4.
links.quote: In a validation benchmark of 420 rare disease cases, KGRD(DS) achieved the strongest overall performance, increased the mean Bond score of the top-ranked diagnosis from 3.27 to 3.85 and raised CIE from 73.6 to 81.9%, corresponding to 35 additional cases with candidate-diagnosis Bond score ≥4.

unlisted_practices: Multi-agent deductive reasoning with collective decision-making and multi-source verification for rare disease diagnosis
Knowledge-graph augmentation to reduce common-attention bias in LLMs

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks KGRD, an LLM- and agent-based reasoning framework augmented with knowledge graphs for rare genetic disorder diagnosis across 420 cases, but does not test organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
